info.title: StockFlow API
info.description:
Multi-warehouse inventory and order management API.

Authenticate with `POST /v1/auth/login` and send the returned token as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details
(`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code` member. `POST /v1/orders`
accepts an `Idempotency-Key` header for safe retries.

post.description: The token is returned once and must be sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
post.summary: Log in and receive an API token
Revoke the token used for this request

Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe: repeating the
same key and body returns the original response without a new order.
Responds 409 `insufficient_stock` (with per-item shortages) when any
line cannot be reserved; in that case nothing is reserved.

Role.title: Role

StockMovementType.description: Every change to stock is one of these movements. Each type has a fixed effect on the two stored quantities (available = on_hand - reserved): type         on_hand    reserved   origin   inbound      +q         0          goods received (API)   adjustment   +/-q       0          stock count correction (API)   reservation  0          +q         order created   release      0          -q         order cancelled   outbound     -q         -q         order confirmed (ships the reservation)
